results.evidence: onClick={() => { duplicateInsight(insight as InsightModel, true); setScenePanelOpen(false) }} closes the panel during duplication, so the overlay no longer covers the copy.
duplicateInsight(insight as InsightModel, true) is still called, with the redirect flag unchanged. The close is an extra call after it and does not replace or suppress it.
setScenePanelOpen(false) is called unconditionally. There is no check of whether the panel is an overlay or docked, so a docked wide-screen panel is closed too.
Both entry points now push `${urls.resourceTransfer('Insight', insight.id!)}?short_id=${insight.short_id}`, in InsightPanelActions and InsightSceneMenuBar.

sourceResourceUrl for 'Insight' returns `resourceShortId ? urls.insightView(resourceShortId as InsightShortId) : ...`. The short id comes from searchParams.short_id via paramsToProps and is passed to it.
When resourceShortId is missing, the same ternary falls back to `urls.savedInsights()`, the insights list.
The Dashboard and Survey cases still return urls.dashboard(resourceId) and urls.survey(resourceId). Only the two insight push calls add the ?short_id parameter.

The card has `@container`. The layout is `flex flex-col @md:flex-row`, and the illustration is wrapped in `hidden @md:block shrink-0`. Below the @md container width it is hidden and the content stacks.

result:
I fixed all three issues but haven't run tests or the app, so none of it is verified.

- **Duplicate on a narrow screen:** the Duplicate action in `InsightPanelActions.tsx` now closes the actions sidebar right after starting the duplicate, so the new copy is visible. I left the Duplicate item in the menu bar (`InsightSceneMenuBar.tsx`) alone.
- **Transfer page Back link:** the Back link used the numeric insight ID, which the insight page can't load. The two "copy to project" buttons (`InsightPanelActions.tsx` and `InsightSceneMenuBar.tsx`) now add `?short_id=<short_id>` to the transfer URL. `ResourceTransfer.tsx` reads it and builds Back with `urls.insightView(short_id)`, the same link used elsewhere to open insights. The transfer itself still uses the numeric ID. If someone opens the transfer URL without `short_id`, Back goes to the saved insights list rather than a broken link.
- **Narrow subscriptions modal:** in `SubscriptionOverviewComponents.tsx`, the empty-state card now responds to its own width instead of the screen's. When it's narrow, the layout stacks and the illustration is hidden. The fallback icon still shows in that case. When it's wide, the illustration sits beside the text as before.

I didn't add or change tests. `resourceTransferLogic.ts` also gained an optional `resourceShortId` prop to carry the short ID through.
